newsitem.title: UK: IBCA assigns C ind rating to Korea Exchange Bank.
newsitem.headline: IBCA assigns C ind rating to Korea Exchange Bank.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it assigned a C individual rating to Korea Exchange Bank and kept unchanged its previously assigned legal rating of 2.
IBCA said in a statement that the individual rating of C reflected the bank's slightly better performance compared with its peer group.
It said it was maintaining unchanged the legal rating as a reflection of its view that the Korean authorities would not allow the failure of any of the country's major banks.
Korea Exchange Bank is the largest commercial bank in Korea in terms of consolidated equity and assets.
In recent years, IBCA said the bank had been making efforts to catch up with its peers in a rapid expansion of its retail customer base.

IBCA said Korea Exchange Bank shared many features in common with its peers among the former government-owned large commercial banks, namely weak profitability and poor asset quality, arising largely from government-directed lending in earlier years.
